== Ingredients ==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] peeled and [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Apple|apple]]
* ½ cup granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]], beaten
* [[Cookbook:Flour|Flour]]
* ¼ cup unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], divided
* ⅛ tsp [[Cookbook:Salt|kosher salt]]
* 2½ [[Cookbook:Quart|quarts]] (2.5 [[Cookbook:Liter|liters]]) [[Cookbook:Peanut Oil|peanut]] or [[Cookbook:Canola Oil|canola oil]]
* [[Cookbook:Powdered Sugar|Powdered sugar]]

== Procedure ==
#Run the apple, sugar, eggs, butter, and salt in the food processor until a thick paste forms.
#Roll paste into 3-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] balls. Dredge balls in flour. Set aside for 2–3 minutes.
#Heat oil to 375°F (190°C). Add paste balls and fry until golden brown and cooked through.
#Drain fritters on a cooling rack. Dust with powdered sugar before serving.
